welcome.subtitleIntro: MoeKoder is a tiny desktop app that burns subtitles into video files —
welcome.subtitleEmphasis: one MKV, one ASS, one MP4 out the other side
welcome.subtitleTrail: Takes about ninety seconds to set up, then it's out of your way. Here's what you're getting into.

burns.title: Burns
burns.body: One MKV + one ASS → one MP4, with the subs baked into the pixels. No external font packs needed on the receiving end.

gpu.title: GPU
gpu.body: NVENC, Quick Sync, or AMF — whichever you have. 6–12× real-time on a modern card. Your CPU stays free.

quiet.title: quiet
quiet.body: No sign-in, no cloud, no telemetry. Launches into a dark window, does one job, disappears from your notifications.

seal.bodyBefore: MoeKoder ships with no video, no subs, no content — and never will. You point it at files
seal.bodyAfter: , it hands back a burned copy. That's the whole deal.

needs.diskSuffix: for the ffmpeg + ffprobe binaries (one-time download)
needs.networkSuffix: for that first fetch — after that, every byte stays local

theme.title: Pick a
theme.subtitleBefore: Six themes, all borrowing their kanji from Japanese color names.
theme.subtitleAfter: is the default — warm, purple, cozy. Changes apply immediately so you can feel them against the wizard.

gate.subtitleDesc: — the open-source tools that decode video, burn subtitles, and mux the output. We fetch the official
gate.subtitleVerify: build, verify it, and drop the binaries in your AppData. One-time, around

engine.title: Fetching the
engine.subtitleIntro: MoeKoder is ffmpeg wearing a yukata — and it needs the binaries. We download the official
engine.subtitleVerify: build, verify its SHA-256 against the manifest, and drop it in your AppData.

preset.title: How
preset.subtitleBefore: This is just the default — you can change it per-encode.
preset.subtitleAfter: is the right answer for ~95% of episodes. The others are there for when you're not in the mood to think.

fast.name: Fast
fast.hint: Quick drafts — watch tonight, delete tomorrow.

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.hint: The everyday setting. 95% of the quality at 40% of the bitrate.

pristine.name: Pristine
pristine.hint: Archival rips for the kept folder. Leave the kettle on twice.

cont.title: Which
cont.subtitleBefore: The outer format — what the file ends in.
cont.subtitleMp4Suffix: plays on every device ever made.
cont.subtitleMkvSuffix: is better if you want to keep your audio choices.

mp4.blurb: Universal. Plays everywhere — Plex, phones, old TVs.

mkv.blurb: Many tracks. Best for multi-audio & soft-subs.

webm.blurb: Open codec. Smaller files, slower encode.

privacy.title: One
privacy.subtitle: Read the list. There's no fine print behind it.

noAccount.title: No account, no sign-in, no email
noAccount.body: MoeKoder doesn't know who you are. There is no server to know who you are.

noTelemetry.title: Zero telemetry, zero analytics
noTelemetry.body: No events, no crash reports, no "product usage metrics". The only network call is the ffmpeg download you just watched.

noNags.title: No update nags
noNags.body: Background update checks are off by default. Click Settings → Updates → Check to look for a new version, or flip the toggle there if you want the app to check on its own.

filesLocal.title: Your files stay on your disk
filesLocal.body: Every byte of every encode is local. No cloud mirror, no temp upload, no "intelligent cache".

sourceAvailable.title: Source-available · auditable
sourceAvailable.body: Every line of what you're running is on GitHub. Read it, audit it, file issues — see the LICENSE for redistribution terms.

done.title: Ready
done.subtitleAfter: to pick your first video and subtitle — the pipeline takes it from there.
